name: claude-pipeline-kit
description: A fleet of subagents that takes a Jira ticket — or a requirement document — from intake to a merge-ready PR, with separate bot identities for research, implementation, review, QA and merge.

orchestrator_bot_github_pat.title: Orchestrator bot GitHub PAT
orchestrator_bot_github_pat.description: Token for the bot that merges PRs. Needs merge rights on the target repo. In single-account mode (ACCOUNT_SEPARATION: false) enter the same token for all five.

backend_bot_github_pat.title: Backend bot GitHub PAT
backend_bot_github_pat.description: Token for the backend implementer. Create branch, push, open/update PR — no merge. In single-account mode (ACCOUNT_SEPARATION: false) enter the same token for all five.

frontend_bot_github_pat.title: Frontend bot GitHub PAT
frontend_bot_github_pat.description: Token for the frontend implementer. Create branch, push, open/update PR — no merge. In single-account mode (ACCOUNT_SEPARATION: false) enter the same token for all five.

reviewer_bot_github_pat.title: Reviewer bot GitHub PAT
reviewer_bot_github_pat.description: Token for the code reviewer. Read PR/diff and submit reviews — no push, no merge. In single-account mode (ACCOUNT_SEPARATION: false) enter the same token for all five.

qa_bot_github_pat.title: QA bot GitHub PAT
qa_bot_github_pat.description: Token for QA. Read PR and submit reviews — no push, no merge. In single-account mode (ACCOUNT_SEPARATION: false) enter the same token for all five.
